name: Claude Code v2.1.299–302 (Oct 14–16)
hook: Four releases in three days. v2.1.302 introduces `CLAUDE_AUTO_MODE_MODEL` to pin a specific model for the client-side auto mode classifier — a direct cost dial for teams on tight budgets. Idle compaction now kicks in automatically after 54 idle minutes on conversations over 200K tokens. v2.1.300 adds the `prompt.change` mod hook (intercept prompts before they reach Claude). Buried in v2.1.302: a formal sunset notice that standalone Claude Design closes December 14, 2026. 131+ combined bug fixes across the four releases.

name: OneWave-AI Claude Code Mods
hook: Team built 12 mods in one night on Oct 2 and open-sourced 10 with 155 tests. Standouts: `launch-codes` (blocks risky bash unless you enter a one-time PIN — confirmed safe when tested with `rm -rf`), `token-ledger` (on-screen spend meter that updates with each tool call), `session-wrapped` (generates a Spotify Wrapped–style summary card at session end). MIT license, install via `/plugin install launch-codes@onewave-ai`.
install: See README — individual mods install via /plugin install <name>@onewave-ai

name: Motion Graphics Skills
hook: 13 Claude Code skills for launch-grade motion graphics rendered entirely in code — no After Effects, no video generator required. Every frame is CSS/SVG written and iterated by the agent. Featured by @charlieautomates in their 'Best Skills Install Order' guide as the go-to motion skill for product launches.

name: Paperclip
hook: Open-source multi-agent orchestration platform with org-chart-style team management, goal assignment, and a unified cost dashboard across agents. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and OpenClaw. 103.5K stars with an active push today — now tracks scheduled routines and plugin support as completed roadmap items. Cloud deploy support in progress.

name: i-have-adhd
hook: ADHD-focused output style enforcer: action first, numbered steps, zero filler closers. Ten communication rules applied to every response — eliminates the three-paragraph preamble before the actual answer. 57.5K stars (up ~5K since last Oct 13 appearance), still trending on HN. MIT, installs in two commands.

name: /brag
hook: Run `/brag` in any project directory and the skill produces a shareable launch video — music, motion, and share copy included — using Hyperframes to render. `/brag-slim` variant targets Opus 5.5 for a leaner output. Hosted version now live at letsbrag.app if you don't want the FFmpeg dependency. 16.4K stars.

name: memU
hook: Wiki-style persistent memory that syncs across sessions, agents, and devices. memU can auto-convert your agent session history into reusable skill files — the memory outlasts the session. Active update today. Works alongside Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor. 14.6K stars. Hosted tier at memu.pro for zero-install setup.

name: Scientific Agent Skills
hook: 177 validated agent skills covering research, science, engineering, finance, writing, and analysis — plus integrations into 100+ scientific databases. Updated Oct 15 with new skills. 52.1K stars on the GitHub topics page today. Compatible with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex.
